messages.author: da33143a8db60ce8
messages.subject: feature request
parts: Could we have a function sign() that computes the sign of a real number (so that sign(x) is -1 if x is negative, 0 if x is 0, or +1 if x is positive)? No big deal but it can be convenient sometimes.

messages.author: 5e0a072a41164542
messages.subject: Re: feature request
parts:
Can Stan also have a "integrate" function to do integrals? Thus if we specify the lower bound, upper bound and the function, integrals will be computed. If the bounds can include unknown parameters, it would be perfect. 

It can be similar with the 'integrate' function in R: http://stat.ethz.ch/R-manual/R-patched/library/stats/html/integrate.html

messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] Re: feature request
parts:
We'll be adding solvers for initial value problems for
systems of ODEs. At least initially, we plan to use Boost's
odeint package:

http://headmyshoulder.github.io/odeint-v2/index.html

I don't know how easy it is to do numerical integration,
which is a slightly different problem. As with ODE
solvers, the we need to be able to take derivatives of the solutions
w.r.t. any parameters (including bounds, for instance).

It looks like that R function does multiple integrals and
uses QUADPACK under the hood. Just today, someone was suggesting
porting QUADPACK to Eigen (we use Eigen for linear algebra
in Stan).

- Bob

messages.author: 20758fda448fdbda
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] Re: feature request

On Friday, July 11, 2014 5:42:08 PM UTC-4, Bob Carpenter wrote:
It looks like that R function does multiple integrals and
uses QUADPACK under the hood.  Just today, someone was suggesting
porting QUADPACK to Eigen (we use Eigen for linear algebra
in Stan).

Bob, I don't know if it matters, but `integrate` in R does one-dimensional integration), and it is based on QUADPACK. The only package I know of that does multivariate integration of some sort is `cubature` (by Steve Johnson of NLOPT fame) and that uses bespoke C routines, I think.

Avi
